symptom: rings and shoes that kept getting tighter
hook: the jaw and skull kept growing long after the rest of the body stopped
whatYouSee: Huge frontal sinuses and a thick skull vault sit above a jaw that juts past the upper teeth.
whyItMatters: Acromegaly is growth hormone excess after the growth plates close and it is almost always caused by a pituitary adenoma. The face, jaw, hands, and feet keep enlarging. It raises the risk of diabetes, hypertension, and heart disease.
treatment: Treatment is usually transsphenoidal surgery to remove the pituitary adenoma. Somatostatin analogues or radiotherapy can treat residual disease.
takeaway: A ballooned sella with frontal bossing and a jutting jaw is acromegaly.

findings: Lateral skull and cervical spine radiograph, facing right, with soft-tissue profile, upper cervical spine and shoulder/upper thorax partly included.

Several large, well-defined, rounded lucent lesions with thin sclerotic or scalloped margins and internal septations in the frontal and anterior parietal calvarium, with a multiloculated 'bubbly' appearance.

Additional large rounded lucent areas in the orbital or frontal skull base region and the mid-face; these overlap the expected orbit and frontal sinus and are partly confluent with the other lucencies.
The calvarium looks diffusely heterogeneous with a coarsened trabecular pattern. Possible diffuse thickening of the vault, particularly posteriorly and occipitally, with a mottled texture.
The skull base and mastoid/petrous region has a honeycomb or coarse trabecular lucent pattern.
The facial bones and mandible are prominent, with the mandible appearing large and the bone texture coarsened.
Teeth are visible and the incisors are in an edge-to-edge or open relationship, with the maxillary incisors appearing flared.
The cervical vertebrae are visible with preserved alignment and no obvious fracture. The vertebral bodies are somewhat prominent with coarse trabeculae.
differential: Polyostotic Paget disease of bone (lytic/mixed phase) with osteoporosis circumscripta and facial involvement
Multiple lytic lesions such as myeloma or metastases, or brown tumors of hyperparathyroidism
anatomyConcerns: The large round lucencies in the frontal and orbital regions are unusually well-circumscribed and regular, and their positions do not follow normal sinus or orbit anatomy. This raises the question of an unusual acquisition or processing artifact, or of a synthetic image, though they could also be real lytic or cystic lesions.
The overlap of the lucencies with the orbit and frontal sinus on a true lateral projection makes it hard to tell pathology from normal sinus air.
The skull is not in a perfect true lateral position, as the mandibular rami and the orbits are slightly offset.

clueFacts.fact: In acromegaly, excess growth hormone and IGF-1 can thicken soft tissue and enlarge the bones of the fingers, so rings often become tight and need to be resized.
In acromegaly, excess growth hormone can enlarge the feet through bone and soft tissue growth, so shoe size often increases and shoes feel tighter over time.
